Kill [[Insatiable Vakar]].

==Quest information==

===Requirements===
Must have access to [[Lion's Arch Keep]], see [[:File:War in Kryta flow chart.png|flowchart]] for details.

===Objectives===
* Kill [[Insatiable Vakar]] in [[North Kryta Province]]
* *BONUS* Kill Insatiable Vakar in [[Hard Mode]]
* See [[Princess Salma]] for your reward

===Reward===
* 2,000 [[Experience]]
* 500 [[Gold]]
* Complete the Base Objective for 7 [[War Supplies]]
* Complete the *BONUS* Objective for an additional 3 War Supplies

==Walkthrough==
Head west out of Lion's Arch or north from D'Alessio Seaboard. There are few enemies along the way and some of them can be avoided. Additional foes will [[popup]] as you approach Vakar's location. You can avoid the [[spawn]] by pulling Vakar away.

==Dialogue==
===Initial dialogue===
;Wanted by the Shining Blade
:''"One of many common brigands that has joined the [[White Mantle]] to drain the lifeblood of Kryta, Insatiable Vakar preys upon the commoners of [[North Kryta Province]]. This feared and despised bandit cannot be allowed to practice his evil trade in Kryta. Queen Salma offers a bounty to the allies of Kryta who permanently rid the land of Insatiable Vakar."''
;After completion of The Battle for Lion's Arch
:''"Relive this classic event from the War in Kryta! One of the many common brigands that joined the White Mantle to drain the lifeblood of Kryta, Insatiable Vakar preyed upon the commoners of North Kryta Province before he was hunted down by command of Salma during the war. Recreate the famed bounty hunt for Insatiable Vakar and claim a royal reward!"''
